name: Fairy Unfortunate
source:
When a certain fairy gets kidnapped by a lone swordswoman, she assumes that, like most fairies, she will be cooked and eaten soon. Things take a dark turn when she realizes the adventurer's motivations aren't quite what she expected. Could their relationship ever become anything more than a strained mess between captor and prisoner? How much pain can you perpetuate in the name of companionship?

[From [url=https://gaybreast.itch.io/fairy-unfortunate]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当某个仙女被一个孤独的女剑客绑架时，她认为，像大多数仙女一样，她很快就会被煮熟并吃掉。当她意识到冒险家的动机并不完全符合她的预期时，事情发生了黑暗的转变。他们的关系是否会变得不仅仅是俘虏和囚犯之间的紧张混乱？你能以陪伴的名义承受多少痛苦？

[来自[url=https://gaybreast.itch.io/fairy-unfortunate]itch.io[/url]]
